name: print-social-ai-business-workflow-post-with-violet-pink-radar-and-feature-grid
title: 'AI that fits your business workflow' post with a violet-pink radar arc and five-feature grid
whatItIs: A square dark post with a violet-to-magenta glow, concentric arcs and a light wedge above a horizon line with a white org-chart icon circle, a centred white headline, and a thin-ruled grid of five features with small colourful icons (Instant Setup, Seamless Integration, Adapts to Your Process, Flexible Across Teams, Business-Ready Results).
whatItMeans: Modern and confident; the radar suggests scanning your business, and the grid gives quick benefits.
techniques: Place a semicircle radar above a horizon line.
Divide features with thin rules instead of cards.
Use tiny coloured icons on a dark field.
Glow a violet-pink gradient behind the hero.

vocabulary.definition: A horizontal rule anchoring a graphic.
